description: Use when the traveler wants to continue on slicktrip.com, wants to send a flights or hotels search to someone (a bucket_list link saves the list for whoever opens it, so never send one), or the account is not connected: builds a link that lands them fully configured without running a search (a flights search with a track_url that starts tracking on arrival, a bucket list that saves on arrival, a hotel search, or the seat tracker).

Leg.description: One leg of a multi-city trip.

destination.description: One airport or city code (JFK, NYCA) or a clear place name. For a city, send the city, not one of its airports.

origin.description: One airport or city code (JFK, NYCA) or a clear place name. For a city, send the city, not one of its airports.

adults.description: Adults. A hotel room prices up to 6 guests in all; vacation rentals up to 16.

airlines.description: Only these marketing carriers, as IATA codes or names.

cabin.description: Cabin class; several joined with + to compare them (economy+business).

depart_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. A second date joined with _ searches both as flexible dates (2026-11-03_2026-11-04); at most 2 per direction.

destination.description: Airport code (JFK), city code for all its airports (NYCA, LOND, ROME, TYOA) or a clear place name; up to 3 joined with _ (JFK_EWR). For a city, send the city (its name or code), not one of its airports: one can miss the cheapest or only flights. Unsure: call find_places.

flight_number.description: seats: the flight to open in the seat tracker.

flight_numbers.description: flights: the itinerary's flight numbers, connections joined with +; adds a track_url that starts tracking on arrival.

hotel_id.description: hotels: open this one hotel from search_hotels.

legs.description: Multi-city trip: the legs in order, each one place per side and one date. When given, origin, destination, depart_date and return_date are ignored.

location.description: hotels: a city, area, landmark or hotel name.

max_price_per_night.description: Highest price per night to show, USD.

max_stops.description: Most stops allowed: 0 nonstop, 1, or 2 (2 or more: any number).

months.description: Months to watch, as names or YYYY-MM. Give this OR start_date + end_date.

origin.description: Airport code (JFK), city code for all its airports (NYCA, LOND, ROME, TYOA) or a clear place name; up to 3 joined with _ (JFK_EWR). For a city, send the city (its name or code), not one of its airports: one can miss the cheapest or only flights. Unsure: call find_places.

travelers.description: Travelers who need a seat (adults and children); fares are for all of them together. One booking holds up to 9 (a larger group gets a suggested split). A baby under 2 on a lap is not counted here.

name: handoff_link

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

note.description: What the links do on arrival

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

setup_url.description: seats with flight_number: seat setup page link

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

track_url.description: flights with flight_numbers: autosave tracking link

title: Link into SlickTrip
